filesToTouch.what: Bring the m0 skeleton controller to the full live-animals hub shape (exemplar: sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js — transpose file-for-file, only set-local imports and GROUPS/copy data differ). Exports: `routes` = [{ method: 'GET', path: hubRoutePath(), options: routeOptions, handler }] — `hubRoutePath()` is the PREFIX-FREE route-shape builder evaluated at module load; the plant plugin's `/plant-products` mount prefix supplies the mount, so the hub is served at `/plant-products/notifications/{journeyId}`. Every URL this controller RENDERS (dashboardHref, backLink, row and section entry hrefs) comes from the PREFIX-BEARING link builders (`dashboardPath()`, `rowEntry`/`sectionEntry`, which resolve `setBase()` per request) — never from a route-shape builder. Internals, all per exemplar: (1) GROUPS — ordered array of { id, rows } per the SIBLING-SET-PLAN §2.1 canonical 12-spoke mapping, ONE GROUP PER SPOKE (each spoke is its own numbered hub heading), containing at this increment exactly the groups whose task rows exist by now: [ { id: 'origin', rows: ['origin'] }, { id: 'purpose', rows: ['purpose'] }, { id: 'commodities', rows: ['commodities'] }, { id: 'additional-details', rows: ['additional-details'] }, { id: 'review', rows: ['review'] } ]. Groups 5-11 (transport, goods-movement, contact, nominated-contacts, documents, traders) and m5 billing are appended by their own section increments (pp-030 onward) — each adds one { id, rows } entry plus copy; the frame this file establishes must make that a one-line append. (2) STATUS_TAG map keyed on L2 bridge statuses: FULFILLED -> { tag: { text: copy.statuses.completed, classes: 'govuk-tag--green' } }, OPTIONAL -> { text: copy.statuses.optional }, IN_PROGRESS -> light-blue tag, NOT_STARTED -> blue tag; statusTag() falling back to NOT_STARTED; CANNOT_START_STATUS = { text: copy.statuses.cannotStartYet, classes: 'govuk-task-list__status--cannot-start-yet' }. (3) buildRowItem(id, answers, scope, evaluation, journeyId): special-cases id === 'review' to buildReviewItem — the review spoke is NOT a task row (FD-12): it resolves the 'review' flow section (sections.find), returns CANNOT_START_STATUS unless sectionGatePasses(section, scope) (the authored scope.readyForCheckYourAnswers gate seeded at m0), else href = sectionEntry('review', scope, journeyId) and status = statusTag(sectionStatus(...)). All other ids: row = taskRowById(id), status = rowStatus(row, answers, scope.inScope, evaluation) (delegating to L2 bridge/status), isHiddenRow(row, status) => row.conditional && status === NA returns null (the mechanism m5 billing's conditional: true row relies on — hidden when isCuc is unanswered/false), rowGatePasses(row, scope) ? openRowItem (href = rowEntry(row, scope, journeyId)) : blockedRowItem. OPTIONAL text-only status is the mechanism the pp-032 nominated-contacts row relies on — never gates. (4) buildGroups mapping GROUPS to { id, caption: copy.groups[group.id], items: rows.map(buildRowItem).filter(Boolean) }. (5) handler: completeOpeningRun(request, h, journeyId); { journey, answers, scope, evaluation } = await state.get(request, h); h.view(view, { pageTitle: copy.title, heading: copy.title, copy, sharedCopy, journeyStrip: journeyStrip(journey), groups: buildGroups(...), dashboardHref: dashboardPath(), backLink: dashboardPath(), breadcrumbs: false }). journeyStrip (shared/kit.js) IS the dynamic reference caption: it renders the notification's single stable referenceNumber plus a status tag driven by `status` — satisfying the standing 'no DRAFT->CHEDPP id-flip' deviation (one stable id, status moves). DO NOT transpose buildCommodityTotals/commodityTotals — a live-animals-only display (animal counts) with no CHED-PP requirement. No POST handler, no form, no contract-table case.

Transpose sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/template.njk minus the commodityTotals block: extends shared/layout.njk; block journeyContent; h1.govuk-heading-xl {{ heading }}; one intro paragraph p.govuk-body {{ copy.intro }} under the H1 ('These sections can be completed in any order. You can save your progress and return at any time.' — carried from the page spec bodyCopy); then for each group: h2.govuk-heading-m {{ group.caption }} + govukTaskList({ idPrefix: group.id, items: group.items, classes: 'app-task-list govuk-!-margin-bottom-8' }); finally govukButton({ text: copy.returnToDashboard, href: dashboardHref, classes: 'govuk-button--secondary' }). govuk-frontend macros only, no custom CSS. Deliberate departures from the legacy page (all ruled/spec-flagged, see notes): NO hardcoded status literals anywhere (the legacy review tag lied), NO href="#" back link and NO back-link+breadcrumbs duplication (real-href back affordance to the dashboard only — standing 'real-href back links' rule), NO Attachments shortcut button (duplicate of the documents row's target; untested legacy accretion), NO phase-tag class.

Review and submit' }; rows keyed by canonical task-row id, each { title, hint }: origin: { title: 'Origin of the import', hint: 'Where the consignment comes from and your internal reference' }, purpose: { title: 'Purpose of the consignment', hint: 'The main reason for importing the consignment' }, commodities: { title: 'Commodity', hint: 'The commodities, species and quantities you are importing' }, 'additional-details': { title: 'Additional details', hint: 'Total gross weight and volume of the consignment' }, review: { title: 'Review and submit', hint: 'Check your answers before you submit the notification' }. notes: RATIONALE: completes the m0 hub skeleton (pp-007) to the ruled 12-spoke experience for everything built through m3. The build is a file-for-file transposition of the live-animals hub feature (G-C — no hub-from-scratch recipe): controller.js is the exemplar for GROUPS, STATUS_TAG, CANNOT_START, buildReviewItem, isHiddenRow and buildGroups; template.njk and copy bundles likewise. RULINGS APPLIED: FD-12 (review = flow section with authored gate scope.readyForCheckYourAnswers, NOT a task row — fixes the legacy hardcoded 'To do' review tag, the page spec's clearest defect); §2.1 (canonical row ids and spoke numbering — each spoke is its own numbered hub heading, so GROUPS degenerates deliberately to one row per group); standing deviations from chedpp-requirements.md: one stable id with status moves (journeyStrip caption replaces the legacy heading-tertiary DRAFT->CHEDPP flip), real-href back links (no href='#', no back-link+breadcrumbs duplication), govuk-frontend toolbox only (no phase-tag, no action-button/button-small). DECISIONS TAKEN HEADLESS: (1) GROUPS at this increment contains only the rows that exist (origin, purpose, commodities, additional-details, review) — rows for unbuilt sections land WITH their section increments per the planning brief; taskRowById on a missing row would throw, so the frame must not reference future rows. (2) Group-caption numbers are authored literally per §2.1 (live-animals precedent), so the rendered sequence reads 1,2,3,4,12 until m4/m5 fill the middle — a transient scaffolding state, accepted to keep the canonical numbers stable. (3) commodityTotals summary cards NOT transposed (live-animals-specific animal-count display; no CHED-PP requirement; read-only rollups belong to pp-028's additional-details page). (4) Attachments shortcut dropped (same target as the documents row, zero test coverage in legacy, spec flags it redundant). (5) Legacy prerequisite-gating of the hub (redirect-away when prerequisites incomplete) is NOT reproduced — reachability policy belongs to entry-guard.js (m0) and the 'complete in any order' promise; the target model's per-row Cannot-start/gate mechanics carry any genuine ordering constraints. (6) No 'Expired' status: the legacy Expired tag maps to no state in the target model (commodity-code validity is enforced at collection time via allowListed gates, not surfaced as a hub status). EXEMPLAR FILES: sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/{controller.js,template.njk,copy/copy.en.js,copy/copy.cy.js,hub.e2e.spec.js}; shared/kit.js (journeyStrip); flow/navigation.js (rowEntry/rowGatePasses/sectionEntry); flow/section-status.js; bridge/status/index.js. OVERLAP DISCIPLINE: earlier section increments (pp-018..pp-028) may already have added some GROUPS entries/row copy per recipe §3.6 — this increment brings the hub to the exact target state described here (idempotent reconciliation), and later increments (pp-030+) append theirs. Not platform-touching (diff confined to the set), so the two-sided live-animals check is not mandated; the full `npm test` step still exercises copy-parity/copy-convention across both sets.
openQuestions: Row hint strings are planner-authored (the legacy hub had no hints) — content design should review the five hints before external exposure.

Group captions render 1,2,3,4,12 until m4/m5 land groups 5-11 — confirm this transient numbering gap is acceptable for the build period (alternative — computing numbers at render — was rejected to keep §2.1 numbers canonical).

The 'Review and submit' completed-state e2e leg cannot run until pp-033 (check-answers) lands; until then the unlock is proven by unit-level synthetic answers only — pp-033 must add the end-to-end unlock assertion.

Legacy hub prerequisite-gating (bounce to next incomplete prerequisite page) deliberately not reproduced — a human should confirm free hub reachability is the intended CHED-PP behaviour (spec openQuestion carried forward).
